primary_comparison: phase_guard versus direct_waypoints: final native full-task success on matched states
mechanism_comparison: deadline_guard versus direct_waypoints tests gating; phase_guard versus deadline_guard tests early arrival exits
policy_context: Fresh per episode, no pilot traces or other condition outcomes; same public sensors/calculation access.
execution_schedule: Serial in the specified order; no concurrent policy episodes. Two rotating blocks; order balance is incomplete and is a limitation.
analysis_rules: Every native failure and budget stop remains in its condition denominator.
Report all six episodes; no optional stopping based on outcomes.
Primary success differences, paired wins/losses and Wilson 95% intervals are descriptive; two states cannot establish equivalence.
Resource differences on all pairs; successful-completion ratios only on pairs where both conditions succeed.
Report failures separately alongside success-denominator inclusion; faster failure is not faster completion.
Report native policy time, delivery delay, simulated motion, host execution and orchestration separately; no real-time claim.
Audit exact policy tools/calculation logs and verify replay for every completed episode.
No changes to thresholds, prompts, controller, source or primary analysis during held-out runs.
Any interruption, crash or protocol violation is retained and reported; do not silently replace a model failure.
No cross-task generalization claim; the two new placements test held-out starts of this task.
failure_criteria: If guards do not improve observed full-task success, the primary predicted success benefit is unsupported in this study.
If reductions in successful-completion resources do not occur, the efficiency explanation is unsupported in this study.
If guards cause harmful cancellations or extra calls, report those costs and revise the mechanism.
A task-success difference alone does not identify gating versus early exit; inspect the deadline control and traces.
pre_evaluation_freeze_note: Before any held-out episode or policy decision, source checks were extended to policy template/dependency material and runtime versions. This supersedes the initial c43dbe2 freeze hashes; no results were observed.

amendments.reason: User requested faster initial screening; three paired starts / nine episodes.
User explicitly requested two states now and future default two, to limit Astra cost.
